lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Easy, girl. We're not obligators, and we're not with Camon anymore either.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Camon will gut you for this. Both of you.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Camon's finished. What matters is what just happened to you when that lock hit the floor. Did you feel it? A pull, right behind your ribs?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: That's a metal in your blood catching fire. You're Mistborn, Vin. There's a way out of here that isn't through Camon's crew. Follow me.
